Argument.description: Result graphic request DTO consumed by the handler to build the on-screen result figure (UFIG).

CURRENT_MODE.description: Current result graphic mode; drives which COMPONENTS key is used. Case-insensitive. Note: this is the /civil endpoint. The DTO also defines INFLL_DESIGN_STEEL/RC/SRC, but on a Civil build those strings resolve to no command (they are _MGEN/building-only in ViewCurrentModeSelector) and the request throws 'Invalid Current Mode', so they are omitted here. The Civil-side design-result graphics ('STEEL/CONCRETE/SRC DESIGN RESULT', 'DESIGN STRIP FORCE/STRESS') are NOT exposed by this API because the DTO_RESULT_GRAPHIC command-mode enum does not serialize those strings.

OPT_CUMULATIVE_DISP_BY_INIT_LOAD.description: Cumulative displacement by initial load option.

COMPONENTS.description: Component selection for the active result. Set exactly the key matching CURRENT_MODE (e.g. REACF for REACTION FORCES/MOMENTS).

PART.description: Construction Stage Part Name ("Total" or "Part N").
